entities.summary: Justin Howard Watson is an American professional football wide receiver for the Houston Texans of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Penn Quakers and was selected by the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in the fifth round of the 2018 NFL draft. Watson is a three-time Super Bowl champion, winning Super Bowl LV with the Buccaneers and Super Bowl LVII and LVIII with the Chiefs.
